page: Google Cloud Platform m3-megamem-64 is a memory-optimized instance featuring 64 vCPUs and 976 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon processor with an x86_64 architecture, this server utilizes 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled running at a clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The CPU configuration includes a 54 MB L3 cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and 48 KB L1d cache. It supports advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA_NI.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory-intensive execution capabilities. The server achieves top-tier performance in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Geekbench multi-core processing. Passmark database operations and CPU encryption tests also rank in the top tier. Conversely, single-core performance remains in the average range, with a Geekbench single-core score of 1577.0 and a stress-ng single-core score of 1852.19. Memory bandwidth tests show 3255.75 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 150.66 GB/sec for uncached large blocks.

From a resource density perspective, the m3-megamem-64 provides a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 15.25 GB per core, making it highly efficient for memory-bound workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration, both of which are absent on this instance. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance, though the 2.6 GHz clock speed presents a tradeoff for single-threaded tasks. This profile is suited for large-scale in-memory databases, enterprise database operations, software compilation, and memory-intensive data processing pipelines.
